supporting_observations.claim: At 13:48 UTC, tess.hart launched an elevated MMC session opening Active Directory Users and Computers; the workstation then connected to the domain controller address over LDAP and RPC. This is consistent with account-management activity, but does not show that guest.rwong was created or what permissions it received.

The account name and apparent actor are consistent with the stated help-desk process for creating temporary guest accounts, but the available records do not verify that this specific creation followed that process.

known_telemetry_limitations: Both Windows Security and Sysmon collection on DC-ORC-01 were unavailable from 13:25 through 14:15 UTC, covering the alert time and the observed workstation ADUC activity; domain-side account creation and change records may therefore be missing.
The provided workstation records show ADUC and connections to the domain controller, but do not contain a domain account creation event or the resulting account attributes and group memberships.
claims_not_established: Whether guest.rwong was actually created at the alert time, who created it, or whether the observed ADUC session performed that creation.
Whether guest.rwong was added only to Volunteers, was given administrator or other elevated privileges, or received an appropriate temporary-account expiration.
Whether the account creation was authorized or tied to a valid help-desk request.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain DC-ORC-01 account-management audit records for the alert window, including creator identity, creation time, account attributes, group membership changes, and any privilege assignments.
Check directory state and audit history for guest.rwong, including its enabled status, group memberships, and expiration settings.
Confirm with tess.hart and the relevant help-desk request or change record whether this specific temporary account was requested and created under the approved process.
unrelated_findings: tess.hart launched the Cisco AnyConnect VPN UI on WS-THART-01 at 13:43 UTC, although the inventory says the organization has no VPN. These records show the UI launch, not a successful VPN connection; investigate separately. (T278-00036, T278-00037, T278-00038)
